item.title: Match Report: Shrewsbury Town 1-2 Walsall
item.description: Walsall secured victory for the first time since the middle of January as a brace from Priestley Farquharson helped see off an in-form Shrewsbury Town side at Croud Meadow. The Saddlers opened the scoring through Farquharson before the Shrews levelled on the brink of half time, but the defender grabbed a brace after the interval, handing an important three points to the Saddlers. item.description: Mat Sadler made sure to thank the supporters on Saturday afternoon as his side were victorious in a local derby over Shrewsbury Town. item.title: Match Report: Lichfield City 2-0 Walsall Women
item.description: Walsall Women fell to a 2-0 defeat to Lichfield City Women at the Trade Tyre Community Stadium on Sunday afternoon. Courtney Dilger’s powerful strike early on in the second half and Skye Wright’s finish from a free-kick sealed the victory for the hosts, despite the Saddlers’ valiant performance. The defeat was Walsall’s first since early October, as their 11-match unbeaten run came to an end against a West Midlands Regional Women’s Football League Division One North table-topping Lichfield. item.description: We are pleased to welcome a new member to the team within the Walsall FC Academy, with Michael Flannery joining us as our new Head of Academy Coach Development.
